findings.comment: Project address (3759 Valley View Road, Austin, Texas 78704) appears on multiple sheet title blocks but no documentation verifying this address with Austin Build + Connect or City of Austin 911 Addressing system has been provided with the site plan submission.

Unit address schema table has not been submitted to City of Austin 911 Addressing Division for review and approval prior to site plan approval. No Excel spreadsheet table, approval correspondence, or addressing review documentation has been provided.

Approved Addressed Floor Plan has not been attached to the site plan set as a separate PDF named 'Approved Addressed Layout' or 'Approved Addressed Floor Plan,' and no separate approved unit schema table has been included in the site plan submission package.

Unit address schema table has not been submitted as an Excel spreadsheet or is not named per convention. The required file format and naming (e.g., 'SP-2025-0126C Valley View Townhomes_Address Unit Numbering Table') are absent.

Unit address schema table does not exist in the submission. A complete table organized by building and floor, with all unique buildings and units listed numerically, blank cells for non-existent units, and no duplicate unit numbers, is required but absent.

Addressing layout has not been submitted as a separate standalone PDF or is not named per convention. Sheet 29 serves as an addressing plan but is not a separately named PDF document (e.g., 'SP-2025-0126C Valley View Townhomes_Address Unit Numbering Plan') required for Addressing Division approval.

Unit numbering does not follow the Building# + Floor# + Unit## schema required by Addressing Standards Figure 2 for multi-building developments. The current plan shows Building# + Unit## numbering (e.g., 101, 102, 201, 202) but lacks floor-level differentiation within the numbering structure.

Townhome units have not been assigned separate independent main street addresses based on their entrance location per Addressing Standards Figure 4. All 39 units are currently addressed to a single shared address (3759 Valley View Road) with unit numbers (101-104, 201-206, etc.). For townhomes with street-facing front doors, each unit must receive its own separate primary street address, not unit numbers at a shared address.

Address verification incomplete. The address (3759 Valley View Road, Austin, Texas 78704) appears on sampled sheets (1, 9, 10) in title blocks and client information areas, but comprehensive verification that the correct address appears on every sheet in the 39-sheet set has not been completed.

Items requiring permits or electrical metering have not been assigned unique address identifiers on the Addressing Layout and Excel schema table as required by Addressing Standards Appendix A. Any present electrical meters, house panels, fire protection elements, or other infrastructure requiring addressing must be identified with standard codes (e.g., ELEV1, CP1, HP1, FIREP) but no such identifiers are shown on the Addressing Plan or in any submitted schema table.

codeCitations: Addressing Standards, Building and Unit Types; UCM 1.9.1.7; UCM 1.5.3.6A
findings.comment: Electrical meters are not individually labeled with building numbers or unit identifiers to establish the meter-to-building and meter-to-unit associations. Sheet 21 (Preliminary Electrical Design Plan) shows meters labeled only generically as 'Electrical Meters' with no unit-specific identification on the plan or in any addressing documentation.

applicableAreas: all electrical meters for individual units
findings.comment: Utility meters for multifamily dwelling units are not labeled with the 911-assigned unit identifier matching the addressing layout. Electrical meters on the Preliminary Electrical Design Plan (Sheet 21) are shown without unit-specific labels and no addressing documentation has been provided to establish the meter-to-unit relationship required by UCM 1.9.1.7.

No note appears on the plan set stating that any changes to street names, building labels, unit configurations, unit arrangements, or access points after Addressing Division approval require a completely new addressing review prior to plan revision approval. General notes sheets (Sheets 1 and 3) do not contain this required policy statement.
